The beacon established C2 communication to 198.51.100.23. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP, resetting the compromised account, scanning the source host, and executing a hardening playbook. The file server showed no signs of malicious process execution or file modifications.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration in Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-10"
    strings:
        $magic = "beacon_config" wide
        $cfg1 = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 }
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.0" wide
    condition:
        $magic at 0x40 and $cfg1 and $http_get
}
